properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 6 at 7:15PM ChST until September 6 at 8:45PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
FFWGUM

The National Weather Service in Tiyan has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Guam...

* Until 845 PM ChST.

* At 715 PM ChST, Doppler radar indicated heavy showers, with the
potential for thunderstorms, producing heavy rain across the warned
area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible in the warned area.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy showers and possible
thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways and streets, as well as other poor drainage and
low-lying areas.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Report flooding to law enforcement.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 6 at 3:05AM CDT until September 6 at 6:00AM CDT by NWS Nashville TN
properties.description:
FFWOHX

The National Weather Service in Nashville has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Cumberland County in Middle Tennessee...

* Until 600 AM CDT.

* At 305 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2.5 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of South Central Cumberland County.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued September 6 at 2:09AM AST until September 6 at 5:00PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
* WHAT...This level of heat can affect anyone without effective
cooling and/or adequate hydration.

* WHERE...Portions of Puerto Rico, particularly across coastal and
urban areas and lower-elevation valleys.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 5 PM AST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Heat-related illnesses increase significantly during
periods of very high heat indices or high temperatures. This
extreme heat event poses a severe threat to anyone with inadequate
cooling or hydration. These extreme impacts will be most pronounced
across coastal sections, lowlands, interior valleys, and urban
areas.
properties.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.

Take extra precautions when outside. Wear lightweight and loose
fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous activities to early morning
or evening. Take action when you see symptoms of heat exhaustion and
heat stroke.

To reduce risk during outdoor work, the Occupational Safety and
Health Administration recommends scheduling frequent rest breaks in
shaded or air conditioned environments. Anyone overcome by heat
should be moved to a cool and shaded location. Heat stroke is an
emergency! Call 9 1 1.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 5 at 8:16PM CDT until September 7 at 1:30AM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Jasper,
Jefferson, Hardin and Orange Counties.

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Jefferson and Hardin
Counties.

...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Village Creek Near Kountze affecting Hardin County.

For the Neches River...including Town Bluff, Evadale, Neches River
Saltwater Barrier...Minor flooding is forecast.
For the Village Creek...including Kountze...Minor flooding is
forecast.
For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Village Creek near Kountze.

* WHEN...Until late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 18.4 feet, The water will be at the low chord of
Highway 418.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 PM CDT Saturday the stage was 19.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:30 PM CDT Saturday was 20.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
tomorrow afternoon and continue falling to 5.0 feet Thursday
evening.
- Flood stage is 17.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 19.3
feet on 03/07/1992.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Sunday afternoon at 215 PM CDT.
